verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a chat front end, so asking whether it can be reached from existing messengers is fair, but the pack shows no native WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack or iMessage chat surface. The closest evidence does not count: webhooks only push notifications to Discord/Slack or post external messages into channels (adjacent feature), the OpenAI-compatible gateway and API keys are developer building blocks, and the PWA is still Open WebUI's own interface.
